title: admitUploadRequest
responsibility: Rejects cross-origin, non-multipart or oversized upload headers before any body read, using each endpoint’s explicit limit.

inputs.name: admitUploadRequest.request
inputs.description: The incoming HTTP request whose Origin, Content-Type, and Content-Length headers control admission. Its body is not read; a missing or nonmatching Origin is rejected first.

inputs.name: admitUploadRequest.targetOrigin
inputs.description: The exact string required in the request's Origin header; comparison is strict and no parsing or normalization is applied. It is checked before content type and size, so a different or missing header is rejected.

inputs.name: admitUploadRequest.limit
inputs.description: The caller-supplied numeric byte threshold checked after Origin and multipart content-type validation. No limit validation is applied; Content-Length is converted with Number(header || 0), and rejection occurs only when the result is greater, so a missing or empty header counts as zero and an invalid value does not compare greater.

outputs.name: admitUploadRequest
outputs.description: Returns null when all header checks pass; otherwise it returns a JSON Response without reading the body. Checks run in order: exact Origin match (else 403, Same-origin upload required), the case-sensitive multipart/form-data prefix (else 415, Multipart form required), then Number(Content-Length || 0) greater than limit (else 413, Upload exceeds size limit).
